test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a single-phase transformer, which instrument is used to check continuity between the primary and secondary windings when they are not energised?

options.text: Use a multimeter set to current
Use a multimeter set to voltage
Use a multimeter set to ohms

solution:
__**Concept**__

Continuity means: 

__
 
• The winding wire is not broken
 
• There is a complete electrical path through the winding

**Explanation**__

When a single-phase transformer is not energised, continuity between windings is checked by measuring resistance.

 
• A multimeter in ohms (Ω) mode checks whether the winding is continuous or open.
 
• A finite resistance reading indicates continuity.
 
• An infinite resistance indicates an open circuit (broken winding).
